name: pets
description: Pets (docs/proposals/pets.md): an animal that lives in somebody's home. A pet is its NPC (flags.pet names its row), which the engine already lists, describes, sends home and lets you pet, plus a row in `pets` holding its body (the cat kit's numbers) and personality. Answers the Room Stage's roomstage.npcBeast hook so the stage draws the NPC as the cat instead of a person. Needs, carers and the pet verbs are still to come.
